title: Great idea, unacceptable quality
text:
Great idea, unacceptable quality. Great idea, unacceptable quality. (Also overpriced, even for the quality level.)

The little fliptop cap piece falls right off in your hand no matter how gently you open and close it.

This is a design defect. The little male parts on the sides of the fliptop that fit into female "half loops" in the lid are simply not long enough not to pop or fall out with ordinary, gentle opening and closing.

Now I have to go to the trouble of returning this item. Very disheartening.
